_comment: Recorded results, with provenance for every number. Rows marked source 'kaggle-notebook' were produced by patchcore-base.ipynb before the module refactor and are transcribed from the project log / surviving cell outputs, not re-run by this code. Rows produced by `python -m defectloc.evaluate` land in results/runs/*.json and are merged in by scripts/make_results_table.py.
dataset: MVTec AD, category 'bottle' (209 train / 83 test images)

rows.label: PatchCore (baseline, Anomalib)
rows.provenance: Anomalib PatchCore run; defect_detection_log.md sec. 'PatchCore baseline'. Reproduce with scripts/patchcore_baseline.py.
rows.note: Reference point, not part of this model. Included to size the gap.

rows.label: Autoencoder v1 - large bottleneck (256x16x16)
rows.provenance: defect_detection_log.md sec. v1. Superseded; no checkpoint retained.
rows.note: Identity shortcut: the 65,536-value latent let the model copy its input through, so defects survived into the reconstruction.

rows.label: Autoencoder v2 - tight bottleneck (64x8x8) + denoising
rows.provenance: defect_detection_log.md sec. v2. A later re-run of the same config (notebook cell 14) gave 0.874 / 0.743 clean and 0.511 / 0.556 lighting - see the run-to-run variance note in the README.
rows.note: Shortcut closed. image-AUROC >> pixel-AUROC: the model knew whether, not where.

rows.label: Autoencoder v3 - local-SSIM anomaly map
rows.provenance: defect_detection_log.md sec. v3, confirmed by the surviving output of notebook cell 17 (0.9373 / 0.8942 clean, 0.5123 / 0.7150 lighting).
rows.note: +15 pixel-AUROC points with no retraining. Lighting image-AUROC at chance is the open bug this repo's scoring fix targets.

rows.label: Autoencoder v3 + median/MAD image score
rows.provenance: Implemented in defectloc/anomaly.py (normalize_map / image_score norm='median_mad') and unit-tested for lighting invariance, but not yet measured on MVTec AD - this machine has no copy of the dataset. Fill this row by running the two commands in README 'Reproducing the table'.
rows.note: Changes scoring only; no retraining. The v3 checkpoint is sufficient.
